blocks.text: Imagine a typical Filipino home, extending exceptional hospitality to a guest. Then the unsatisfied guest started demanding more. Before anyone knew it, the guest was already acting like the host. That is not just a metaphor. It is a named principle among the Thirty-Six Stratagems, the ancient Chinese compendium of tactics for war and statecraft: “turn the guest into the host.” After the Chinese Embassy criticized a law-enforcement raid this year, the Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission said in a statement: “As diplomatic representatives hosted by our nation, lecturing host authorities on lawful domestic operations is inappropriate.” That sentence already makes plain […]...
